handoff.salientSummary: Implemented high-load test suite for VAL-CROSS-010 with 9 test cases covering 20 concurrent evaluations, semaphore limiting, resource starvation prevention, and data isolation verification.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created high-load test suite in internal/service/high_load_test.go with 9 test cases: (1) TestHighLoad_20ConcurrentEvaluations verifies 20 evaluations created within 1 second with unique UUIDs, (2) TestHighLoad_ConcurrentStartAndComplete tests concurrent start/complete without race conditions, (3) TestHighLoad_20ConcurrentWithSemaphoreLimit tests semaphore limiting, (4) TestHighLoad_ResourceStarvationPrevention ensures no starvation under load, (5) TestHighLoad_PerformanceMeasurement measures performance metrics, (6) TestHighLoad_NoCrossContamination verifies data isolation, (7) TestHighLoad_ConcurrentStatusUpdates tests optimistic locking, (8) TestHighLoad_ConcurrentCancelAndComplete tests deterministic terminal state, (9) TestHighLoad_30SecondsSustainedLoad tests sustained load.

commandsRun.observation: All 9 high-load tests pass including 20 concurrent evaluations (345µs), semaphore limiting, performance measurement, and 30s sustained load (295 evaluations)
All tests in all packages pass
Build and vet pass with no issues
